transcript.text: Bosch built-in microwave BFL524MS0B randomly stops part way through cooking, time still on the display. Opening and closing the door lets it carry on. Maybe once every few days.

This behaviour suggests the microwave thinks the door has opened during cooking. The most common cause is a dirty or worn door latch mechanism not engaging fully, though it could also be an intermittent electrical fault in the door interlock switches. Please check the following safely:
1. Unplug the microwave.
2. Look closely at the plastic hooks on the edge of the door and the slots they click into. Is there any food or grease blocking them?
3. Close the door gently and see if it clicks firmly into place, or if it feels loose/floppy. Let me know what you find.

There was some grease around the door hooks and latch slots, so I cleaned it off, but it's still stopped once since. It does seem to happen more when I close the door gently. No smell, sparks or tripping anything.

The plastic latch hook on the door is likely worn or slightly misaligned so it doesn't push the internal switch far enough in during a soft close. Please try closing the door firmly with a bit more snap for a few cooking cycles to see if that stops the fault.
